item.title: Itadaki Djungarian R
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Studio Miris
  • 発売日: 2005-08-05
  • スコア: 7.07/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: いただきじゃんがりあんR
  • 英語名: Itadaki Djungarian R

别名

  • いたじゃんR

あらすじ

One year since then…

Now, a new battle was about to begin…

“It’s a disaster, a total disaster, big brother!”

As if shattering the brief period of peaceful daily life, Suzune’s voice rings out through Jangarian. To Kazumi, who asks what’s wrong, Suzune points toward the window she just opened.

“W-What did you say!?”

item.title: Majiresu!! ~Omatase Little Wing~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • 発売日: 2004-07-16
  • スコア: 6.21/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: まじれす!!～お待たせリトルウイング～
  • 英語名: Majiresu!! Omatase Little Wing

别名

  • Maji-Res

あらすじ

The World Family Restaurant Association holds a prestigious national tournament.

Last tournament was won by protagonist’s older brother who married the best waitress of the competition. One day older brother dies on his way back to Japan. His wife asks protagonist to take the lead, but this whole situation for him. But when team’s coach collapses in the middle of the match even main character can’t stay aside without giving a fight. He will take the challenge and become the best coach of all times!

  • 日本語名: うさみみデリバリーズ!!
  • 英語名: Usamimi Deliveries!!

あらすじ

There is a city on a floating island. It’s forbidden to construct high buildings there, so all the construction moves underground creating a vast automated infrastructure network.

Main character works for a courier company there. But one day rival courier appears stealing all the customers. Suddenly protagonist gets an offer to work for this new company with amazing rabbit girls that serve as the main attraction of the company. He can’t really say “no” to such offer.

item.title: Tsukikagerou
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Studio Miris
  • 発売日: 2001-10-19
  • スコア: 6.88/10 (36 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 月陽炎
  • 英語名: Tsukikagerou

别名

  • Tsuki Kagerou.rar␠

あらすじ

Taishou era. The interval between Meiji and Shouwa.

A season where yellow and red petals swoop down from the trees.

A young man comes down from the Imperial city, clinging to a large trunk, faintly smiling at the sight of the streets, a suitable young man indeed.

Just as told by his father, he reached to this town to help for an autumn festival. Walking down the streets brings a surge of nostalgia.
